headlines.headline: Regular season opens Monday with No. 1 Florida as preseason favorite, Michigan still shadowed by coaching change
headlines.detail: Florida enters as the unanimous preseason No. 1 for the first time since 2006, ahead of Duke, Illinois, UConn and Texas, while defending champion Michigan (No. 16) adjusts to Dusty May's departure for SMU.

headlines.headline: Emirates NBA Cup group play tips off Friday, adding in-season stakes to an already front-loaded schedule
headlines.detail: The Emirates NBA Cup's group-play slate begins tonight across all four groups, with tonight's games counting double toward both standings and group seeding.

headlines.headline: Saints hand rookie Tyler Shough the starting job for Sunday as Week 8 trade-deadline maneuvering continues
headlines.detail: New Orleans named rookie QB Tyler Shough its starter for Sunday as trade speculation builds ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline, following the Cardinals-Texans Marvin Harrison Jr. swap.

headlines.headline: All eyes on Lincoln: Washington-Nebraska Saturday headlines a slate set up by the CFP committee's first rankings next week
headlines.detail: Washington-at-Nebraska — the programs' first-ever meeting as Big Ten members — headlines the weekend before the CFP committee's first rankings on Tuesday, Nov. 3.
